questions.question: God told Joshua to set apart cities of refuge. Who was allowed to flee to one of them?

answers.text: Someone who kills another by accident
Someone who steals from a neighbor

questions.question: God said the elders of a city of refuge must not hand over an accidental killer to the avenger of blood chasing him. True or false?
How long did God tell Joshua an accidental killer must stay in a city of refuge?

answers.text: Until his trial and the high priest's death
Until the avenger of blood gives up
Until seven full years have passed

questions.question: Joshua set apart six cities of refuge in Israel. Who were these cities appointed for?

answers.text: The Israelites and the foreigners among them
The Israelites but not the foreigners
The foreigners but not the Israelites
